title: Gap to the department head
statementMd:
For each employee with a department, show how much less they earn than the head of their department (the department member whose `manager_id` is NULL). Exclude the heads themselves. Show first name and the gap.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `gap`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Join employees to employees of the same department where `manager_id IS NULL`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.first_name, h.salary - e.salary AS gap FROM employees e JOIN employees h ON h.department_id = e.department_id AND h.manager_id IS NULL WHERE e.manager_id IS NOT NULL;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
